name: polisdk-monorepo
description: PoliSDK — Modular TypeScript SDK & platform for Politecnico di Milano automation, authentication, and student services.

scripts.probe:live: node -e "process.env.POLIAUTH_LIVE_PROBE='1'; import('node:child_process').then(({spawnSync}) => { const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs', 'run', 'packages/poliauth-playwright/tests/live-portal-probe.test.ts'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(r.status ?? 1); })"
scripts.probe:live:auth: node -e "process.env.POLIAUTH_LIVE_PROBE='1'; process.env.POLIAUTH_LIVE_AUTH_PROBE='1'; import('node:child_process').then(({spawnSync}) => { const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs', 'run', 'packages/poliauth-playwright/tests/live-portal-probe.test.ts'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(r.status ?? 1); })"
